title: Scalar-action map of an ordinary derived module
statement: Let $A$ be an arbitrary commutative ring and $K$ an object of the ordinary unbounded module derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the closed derived tensor and internal Hom $R\operatorname{Hom}_A$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let $e_A:A[0]\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf 1$ be the canonical tensor-unit identification. Define the scalar-action morphism $s_K:A[0]\to R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K,K)$ as $e_A$ followed by the tensor-Hom transpose of $\operatorname{id}_K$; equivalently it is the transpose of the unit action $K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A[0]\to K$. No finiteness, boundedness, nonzero-ring or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0BZW, lemma-relative-dualizing-algebraic (1)(c), the scalar-action arrow A → RHom_A(K,K); canonical transpose-of-unit-action construction.
